bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (2D implicit animation only); springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (2D frame rotation); no 3D scene graph, mesh, camera, light, physics or particle code
summary: SceneKit is a 3D scene graph (nodes, cameras, lights, materials, geometry, physics, particles, audio, shaders). BifrOSt has no 3D scene, mesh or camera type anywhere in the SDK, UI or render crates; its rendering is 2D. Apple deprecated SceneKit in favour of RealityKit, so a 3D gap is expected on a 2D macOS-style desktop and most rows are n/a or gap.

features.note: The node tree, pose composition, world matrices and handle checks are tested in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-19.rs (scene3d). Gap: nodes carry no geometry, nothing is removed from a scene, and no renderer draws the tree.
